newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish troops say kill 33 rebel Kurds.
newsitem.headline: Turkish troops say kill 33 rebel Kurds.

text.p: Turkish security forces killed 33 rebels of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) in clashes over the past two days, the emergency rule governors' office said on Friday.
Troops killed 15 of the guerrillas in the southeastern province of Siirt, eight in Sirnak, four each in Bitlis and Bingol and two in Batman, the governors' office, based in Diyarbakir, said.
It gave no military casualty figures.
More than 22,000 people have died in the PKK's 12-year fight for self-rule in the southeast of the country.
